en: Whoa... There are so many people!!

jp: ここはヴェローナの街だ
en: This is the city of Verona.

jp: なんだか、目が回りそうだよ
en: It's a big city. I feel kind of dizzy.

jp: 長旅の疲れもあるだろう
en: You must be tired from the long journey as well. Let us rest a while.
I'm fine, really.

jp: 無理をすることはない
空を飛ぶことは想像以上に
en: There is no need to push yourself. Flying takes more out of you than you would think.

jp: 今日はもう休みなさい
en: Rest for today.
Yeah... but

jp: 飛ぶことを覚えたばかりで
en: You only just learned to fly. Covering that distance must have been hard, was it not?

jp: 最初はちょっと辛かったけれど
今はもうへっちゃらだよ
en: Yeah. It was a little rough at first, but now it's a piece of cake.
I see.

jp: 途中から、だんだん変な感覚に
のみ込まれそうになって怖かった
en: But partway through, a strange feeling almost swallowed me up. It was scary.
A strange feeling?

jp: もっと高くって誰かがささやいて
en: Like someone was whispering to me. Faster, higher...

jp: この翼はいったい誰のものなん
en: Hey, Johannes. Whose wings are these, anyway...?

jp: 私はその質問には答えられない
en: Forgive me, but I cannot answer that question.

jp: この街に来た理由なのだが
en: Setting that aside, as to why we came to this city.

jp: プロデヴォン教団に反目する
地下組織が存在するらしい
en: An underground group that opposes the Prodevon Church is said to exist in this city.
An underground group?
Its name is Cypherpunk.

jp: うまく＜サイファーパンク＞に
接触出来れば、教団の情報を
得られるかもしれない
en: If we can make contact with Cypherpunk, we may be able to learn about the Church.

jp: マティアの手がかりが
少しでも得られるといいのだが
en: I hope we can find even a small clue to Matia's whereabouts.

jp: まずは＜サイファーパンク＞に
接触する方法を見つけなくては
en: First, we must find a way to make contact with Cypherpunk.
I'm going with you!!
But...
I can't just sit still.
I see.

jp: カインは街の中心部で
出来るだけ多くの人に話しかけて
en: Cain, go to the center of the city and try talking to as many people as you can.

jp: 私は他を当たってみる
en: I will try elsewhere.

jp: あまり無茶をしないように
en: Do not do anything reckless.

jp: お前の元に駆けつけられるとは
en: I will not always be able to rush to your side at a moment's notice.
Yeah, I'll be careful.
Young man
Bonjour
Cain
